newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah jolted on Thai baht float.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah jolted on Thai baht float.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah plunged briefly against the dollar in early trading on Wednesday following the flotation of the Thai baht, dealers said.
Dealers said the rupiah nose-dived to a low of 2,445.0 against the dollar in early traqde.
They said said brief uncertainty sent the rupiah down, but it recovered very quickly to its opening level around 2,433.0/35.0.

Thailand's Finance Minister Thanong Bidaya said on Wednesday that effective immediately the country's exchange rate system would be a managed float, whereby the value of the baht would be set by market forces.
One U.S. bank dealer said operators had expected that Thailand would announce a currency devaluation, and that the market was surprised by the managed float.
